annotations.title: Check if a name is free

description: For up to 5 names, see whether the domains (.com.br, .com and .app unless you say) and the social handles look free, with links to search trademarks at INPI, USPTO and EUIPO. `available` means no record was found, not that it is yours; `unknown` means nobody answered. Each name whose handles are checked uses one of the day's handle checks. Costs no credits.
name: check_names
title: Check if a name is free
